data_quality: Re-verified against primary sources on 2026-09-24; see research/REPORT.md and research/metrics/2026-09-24.json. Corrections not yet reflected in thesis text (they need a schema v2 via promote, with an approver): ENA unlock is 2026-10-02 (not 10-05) and USDe supply is $4.89B; SUI unlock goes to the Community Reserve; AAVE protocol revenue is ~$97M/yr (not $402M), so AAVE is recommended for watch-only. Unlock amounts remain unverified (Tokenomist Pro).

finalists.name: BTC
finalists.thesis_short: ETF creations flipped 2026 flows positive; funding moderate, not euphoric. Trend-following on flow, not a valuation call.
finalists.invalidation_short: ETF flows turn net negative for a week, or funding above 0.03%/8h with falling price, or daily close back below the September breakout.

finalists.name: ETH
finalists.thesis_short: Open interest at a four-month high with ETF flows mixed; a leverage-led move that can run or unwind. Trade both sides.
finalists.invalidation_short: OI keeps rising while price stalls (crowded longs), or ETF outflows resume for a full week.

finalists.name: SOL
finalists.thesis_short: Twelve straight weeks of US spot ETF inflows and ~70% staked supply; Alpenglow finality upgrade is a speculative catalyst (still in testing, no confirmed mainnet date).
finalists.invalidation_short: ETF inflow streak breaks, or Alpenglow slips with no date, or network outage.

finalists.name: HYPE
finalists.thesis_short: Organic fee revenue routed to programmatic buybacks; value accrues to the token. But price is near ATH and a core-contributor unlock lands 2026-10-06.
finalists.invalidation_short: Unlocked tokens are claimed and sent to exchanges, fee revenue drops sharply, or adverse US regulatory action.

finalists.name: AAVE
finalists.thesis_short: Aavenomics 3.0 (live since 2026-06-27) routes protocol revenue to open-market buybacks; revenue is organic interest spread, not emissions.
finalists.invalidation_short: Borrow revenue keeps falling, buyback budget cut again, or a bad-debt event on a major market.

finalists.name: ENA
finalists.thesis_short: Fee switch passed but only activates when USDe supply reaches $7.5B; supply was reported at $4-4.75B. ~$212M unlock on 2026-10-05. Event-driven short bias only.
finalists.invalidation_short: USDe supply climbs quickly toward $7.5B, or funding turns deeply negative (crowded short), or the unlock is absorbed without price impact.

finalists.name: SUI
finalists.thesis_short: Scheduled 2026-10-01 unlock adds supply; event-driven short bias into and just after the unlock.
finalists.invalidation_short: Unlock absorbed with rising spot volume and positive flow, or funding deeply negative before the event.
